audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 were shipped as 'Skill' while every one of their whys describes you holding max range against a champion with a 300-range closer.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is all seven rows to Ziggs, and the already-audited mirror set all seven rows to the packet sides as one atomic group. The 33.33% figure is a 9-game sample and cannot outweigh 681 games behind the mirror.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set to Ziggs in both layers; ratings mirrored — 5/10 at level 1, 7/10 through the poke phase, 6/10 once his R and first item are online.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and levels 4-5 were written as though his gap-close arrives on E, so the real spike — Stormbringer — was never given a cooldown or a plan.
audit.why: Stormbringer is 160/135/110s at 550 range: it is the leap, it disables your tower and adds health. Sky Splitter is a 1200-range lightning bolt on a flat 16s that shields him only if he stands in his own blast radius. His level 6 is a 160s all-in, which is why the poke phase stays yours.
audit.corrected: whys[3] and whys[4] rewritten with Stormbringer's 160s and Sky Splitter's real role.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Sky Splitter (E) a leap and Frenzied Maul (W) a root, and spikes[0].text literally ships the author's uncertainty as text: 'his Sky Splitter (W... actually E) leap'. Neither ability does what the page says.
audit.why: Riot kit: Sky Splitter (E) is a 1200-range lightning bolt, 16s, slow plus a self-shield only if he is inside the blast; Frenzied Maul (W) is 325 range on 5s, applies on-hit effects and heals him on the second cast into the same target; Thundering Smash (Q) is 300 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, gives speed toward enemies and stuns on the attack, and is an auto-attack reset. There is no root anywhere in his kit.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, mid, whys[3], whys[4], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[2] rewritten with the real abilities; dontsFull[0].d now carries Frenzied Maul's on-hit heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d promised a guarantee with no number attached.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 and is the only tool that reaches you before level 6 — its downtime is literally the step-up window.

edits.before: Volibear has to walk into your range to do anything, so poke him with Q and pre-place E minefield in front of you; his Sky Splitter (W... actually E) leap is his gap-closer, so keep the minefield on the spot he'd land.
edits.after: Volibear has to walk into your range to do anything, so poke him with Q and pre-place E minefield in front of you; Thundering Smash (12s) gives him speed toward you and stuns on the attack, so mine the ground between you.

edits.before: Even with early tank/bruiser items Volibear must close the gap, and your Luden's burst plus W disengage punish every commit; keep max range and blast him off the instant his E leap lands.
edits.after: Even with early bruiser items Volibear must walk in, and your first-item burst plus Satchel punish every commit; keep max range, buy Grievous Wounds for Frenzied Maul, and blast him off when he closes.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 you keep the range advantage: his one gap-closer is the E leap, which is telegraphed and lands on your pre-placed minefield, so sidestep and punish. Force him to commit E defensively and he has nothing left to reach you.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 you keep the range advantage: Sky Splitter is a 1200-range bolt that shields him only if he stands in his own blast, and Thundering Smash (12s) is his only way in — mine that ground and hold your step-ups for its downtime.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep max range and punish his E leap on the minefield.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you hold max range; Sky Splitter pokes but can't close.

edits.before: At 6 you pre-drop E and W-disengage his R dive before it kills you.
edits.after: At 6 Stormbringer (160s) dives you — hold Satchel for the leap.

edits.before: Keep max range so his E leap is his only way in
edits.after: Keep max range so only his R can reach you

edits.before: Land his E leap-in to close the gap and slow you
edits.after: Land Sky Splitter's slow then Q-smash into you

edits.before: Stick to you with W root once he's in melee
edits.after: Heal off you with Frenzied Maul in melee

edits.before: Volibear spends Thundering Smash (Stun) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is down 12s at rank 1 — a spent stun is your window to step up and keep poking.

edits.before: That’s Volibear’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s heal that applies on-hit — never let him get free autos off.

notes: The worst thing on this page was spikes[0].text shipping the author's own confusion verbatim — 'his Sky Splitter (W... actually E) leap' — plus a Volibear 'W root' that does not exist. Both fixed. Chart sides taken from the mirror and the packet; note the packet's 33.33% is 9 games while the mirror worked from 681, so I did not let the small sample drive the ratings.
